emulator.name: analog-emu (trigcondition's Rytm and A4 emulator built on rytm-emu; its history holds rytm-emu c5732f0, 951dcbc and e914f46)
emulator.settings: no card image, JIT on, --every 1000M; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; two short TRIG presses (12M) open BD's EUCLIDEAN page; one value step on EUC and five on PL1; then thirty-two value steps on OP (encoder 7), each followed 150M later by a zero-count turn only to take a frame. OP passes OR, XOR, AND and SUB, then shows OR* (turn20), XOR* (turn22), AND* (turn25) and SUB* (turn27). Stock 1.74 with the same input shows the same EUCLIDEAN page (step06_TRIG.png byte-identical) and stops at SUB. The 12M presses follow MODULE_UI_CAPTURES.md: from rytm-emu e914f46 a 40M press reads as a hold.
